subject: On-prem admin provisioning & SSO/SCIM cutover — proposed playbook
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Samantha Woods <samantha.woods@acme.io>
Cc: procurement@acme.io
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: On-prem admin provisioning & SSO/SCIM cutover — proposed playbook

Team / Samantha,

Attached is the first cut of the cutover playbook for the Acme private deployment: an ordered checklist that covers identity, access, network reachability, and rollback steps. High-level goals:
- Migrate Acme's IdP integration to the private control plane (SAML 2.0 with IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows)
- Provision SCIM sync for user + group mapping into our private control plane with delegated admin roles
- Ensure network egress rules and firewall allow control-plane telemetry & metrics to Redwood endpoints for the duration of the maintenance window

Ask: please review focusing on three areas by EOD today so we can lock the maintenance window for Fri 18 Jun 02:00-04:00 UTC:
1) SCIM attribute mappings and role names (Priyom) — confirm we can map Acme groups to the three admin roles we expose (admin, devops, observer).
2) Network / firewall checklist (Dev) — confirm IP ranges & ports and whether an explicit TLS proxy will be needed.
3) Rollback safety nets and audit trail (Marcus/Vanessa) — we need language that satisfies Acme procurement for auditability (SOC2 evidence points).

Attachments: playbook-cutover-checklist.pdf (PDF, 85KB)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB-playbook-cutover-checklist

Thanks — I tried to keep the playbook minimal. If we need a deeper runbook for step-by-step commands we can add it as an "engineer runbook" document after this.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Lead, Product Ops — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Woods <samantha.woods@acme.io>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem admin provisioning & SSO/SCIM cutover — proposed playbook

Kim — quick pass from the SCIM side. A couple of notes inline: 

- SCIM attribute mapping: Acme needs email, displayName, externalId, groups. They also want department and title on user objects for downstream entitlements. I attached a short CSV with proposed attribute names that match Acme's HR export.
- Roles: we should avoid the ambiguous "observer" label; Acme security prefers "auditor" mapped to a read-only role that never gets token write privileges. Can we rename for clarity?
- Provisioning cadence: suggest incremental sync during the first 24 hours post-cutover (every 5 minutes) before settling into hourly once stable.

I flagged two items that need product confirmation: what group-to-role rules are editable by Acme admins vs. locked by Redwood. Priyom

Attachments: scim-attr-map.csv (CSV, 3KB)

On Tue, Jun 15, 2027 at 09:12 Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Woods <samantha.woods@acme.io>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem admin provisioning & SSO/SCIM cutover — proposed playbook

Thanks — network notes from infra: 

1) Required egress: control-plane endpoints are hosted in us-west-2. During the maintenance window we only need outbound TLS to these endpoints. IP ranges: 3.5.8.0/24, 54.210.16.0/23 (we will provide a final list 48 hours prior). Ports: 443 (TLS) and 5228 (metrics push via mTLS) — confirm whether Acme needs a dedicated NAT gateway for the agents.
2) SAML metadata: I'll post the SP metadata file under the Drive link and also attached here. Acme needs to upload the metadata to their IdP (Okta) and verify the certificate fingerprint.
3) TLS proxy: if Acme runs an egress TLS proxy that performs TLS-interception, we need an exemption for agent traffic or a mutual-TLS (mTLS) option. Recommend mTLS for the agent -> control-plane metric path.
4) Ports for SCIM: outbound 443 to our scim API endpoint; no inbound ports required.

Attachments: saml-metadata.xml (XML, 6KB)

Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem admin provisioning & SSO/SCIM cutover — proposed playbook

Thanks everyone — Acme confirms the Fri 18 Jun 02:00-04:00 UTC window. A few items from our side: 

- Procurement: we need the final audit language that will be shared with our compliance team (SOC2 items, logging retention windows, and who we can contact for an audit). Can you point to where in the playbook we list the evidence artifacts?
- IdP: we will upload the SP metadata to Okta tomorrow and schedule a test with our SSO admin. We will also provide the initial admin and auditor groups for mapping.
- Rollback: if we detect SCIM provisioning errors during the first sync, we will stop and rollback to the previous group-membership state. Who is the on-call for rollback?

Samantha Woods
Head of Cloud Operations, Acme.io

Subject: Re: On-prem admin provisioning & SSO/SCIM cutover — proposed playbook (DECISIONS & ACTIONS)

Quick summary and owners — thanks for the fast turn: 

Decisions (agreed):
- Role naming: change "observer" to "auditor" (Priyom to update SCIM map).
- SCIM attribute set: include email, displayName, externalId, groups, department, title (Priyom to confirm CSV update).
- Network: Dev will publish final IP ranges 48 hours before the window. mTLS will be enabled for metrics; control-plane API uses TLS.
- Audit evidence: Marcus to collate SOC2 artifact list and point to Drive folder; procurement@acme.io will be copied on the artifact handoff.

Action items (owner — due):
- Priyom: update scim-attr-map.csv and post final mapping (due Thu 17 Jun 16:00 PDT).
- Dev: finalize IP ranges and NAT guidance; confirm whether a NAT is required (due Thu 17 Jun 18:00 PDT).
- Marcus: produce the "audit evidence checklist" (Drive + links) and place under the playbook folder (due Thu 17 Jun 12:00 PDT).
- Vanessa: run the rollback runbook dry-run and confirm the timed steps (due Thu 17 Jun 20:00 PDT).

Jira: INFRA-789 has been created for the cutover and task tracking: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-789
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB-playbook-cutover-checklist

If there are no blockers I will confirm the maintenance window with Acme procurement and schedule the runbook hand-off meeting Thu 17 Jun 09:00 PDT.

—Kimberly
